project_info.theme: Messy-hair young man with Persian cat close-up
project_info.color_palette: soft white, warm gray, neutral wall tones, golden eyes, dark hair

main_subject.detail: A young man named Noor with long, messy, voluminous dark hair holds a fluffy white Persian cat in front of his face. His intense gaze is partly visible above the cat's head. The cat has bright golden eyes, a soft pink nose, and looks confidently into the distance.

items: the fluffy white Persian cat fills the foreground and obscures the lower half of the man's face
the man's partially visible eyes create the secondary focal point above the cat

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: gentle even illumination with natural fur and hair texture

technical_specs.render_style: photorealistic close-up portrait with shallow depth of field
technical_specs.color_treatment: soft neutral indoor tones and realistic white-fur detail

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Close-up portrait of a young man Noor with long messy, voluminous dark hair, holding a fluffy white Persian cat in front of his face. The cat has bright golden eyes and a soft pink nose, looking confidently into the distance. The background is minimal, with soft indoor lighting and neutral wall tones. The man's intense gaze is partially visible over the cat's head, creating a calm yet intriguing composition. Cozy and natural atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed, distorted cat anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional person and cat references may be attached. Preserve Noor's messy dark hair and partially visible gaze, plus the Persian cat's white fur, golden eyes, pink nose, foreground scale, and face-obscuring placement. The room may be replaced while retaining soft indoor neutral light.
